notes: Rule 3: coincasa.it is a live 301 redirect to www.coin.it/it-it/ (robots.txt Sitemap also points to coin.it). Coincasa (the Italian home/lifestyle chain) has been merged into Coin's unified department-store site, which is now titled 'Coin - Coincasa | Arredo Casa Shop Online | Abbigliamento e beauty' and runs on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Sites-coin_eu-Site). The Coincasa brand survives only as a franchise concept (footer link 'Franchising Coincasa') and as the home-goods department of coin.it (paths under /it-it/shop-casa/ and /it-it/casa/). Extracted the live coin.it home-decor catalogue and documented the domain mismatch per Rule 3. Access route: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking encountered, no ClaudeBot disallow in robots.txt. Counts verified via the 'Vedi risultati N Prodotti' header cross-checked against the JSON-LD ItemList item count and, for categories >56 items, against the 'Hai visualizzato 56 di N prodotti' load-more progress text (all three sources agreed on every category checked this way). EXCLUDED (checked, out of scope): Posate/cutlery, Tovaglie-Tovaglioli/Runner/Tovagliette/Cuscini per sedie/Grembiuli-Strofinacci/Presine (all textiles), Accessori e utensili cucina (kitchen tools, 62 products), Contenitori e Cestini (title-checked: mostly kitchen storage jars/general baskets, not decor, 27 products), Cesti e organizer (title-checked: hangers/shoe horns/drawer organizers, 13+ products), Articoli da ufficio (office supplies), Candele e diffusori (title-checked: 14 products, mix of decorative unscented candles/votives AND explicitly 'candela profumata' scented candles in one unified listing with no separate unscented-only URL -- dropped the whole node per the Home-Fragrance rule), Accessori bagno (title-checked: toothbrush holders/soap dishes/laundry baskets -- functional bathroom hardware, not decorative, per Rule 0.4), all of Camera da letto/Bagno/Tessili casa (bedding, towels, curtains, cushions -- textiles), all of Mobili incl. Complementi d'arredo (title-checked: balcony furniture sets, bar carts, coat racks -- furniture), all of Outdoor except Lanterne e Vasi da esterno (garden furniture, beach/picnic gear, gardening), Aria di Bianco branch (title-checked: a seasonal 'Fiera del Bianco' sale/marketing collection cross-cutting the same Soggiorno/Tavola e Cucina catalogue by promotional filter, not a distinct taxonomy -- e.g. its 'Soggiorno' node literally shows 'Filtra per Categoria: Zerbini' confirming it is a re-cut of the main tree), Editoriali (brand/collection landing pages -- Society Limonta, Zefiro, Linen joy etc., all bed/bath linens), Regali (gifts/holiday, never-extract). Rule 0 gains: none of the room-word exclusion traps applied here since the merged Coin catalogue has no per-room lighting or mirror sub-tree (Illuminazione interni and Specchi are each single flat leaf nodes) -- but Rule 0.4 was actively applied to correctly exclude Accessori bagno (functional bathroom hardware) while nothing bathroom-related qualified for inclusion in this catalogue. 'Lanterne e Vasi da esterno' (11 products) is a genuine outdoor decor node kept per Rule 0.5 despite the Outdoor room word; its contents are a mix of decorative rope/jute baskets, metal candlesticks and lanterns -- documented as an overlap/mixed listing but kept since the node's own name and majority character (candle holders, lanterns) are in-scope decor types, not garden furniture or utility items. Tazze, mug e tazzine (105 products) is a genuine SEO-style flat-URL category (not under /shop-casa/) but is directly linked from the primary Tavola e Cucina mega-menu column and independently verified via canonical URL + matching load-more progress text, so it was kept and grouped under Kitchen & Dining. All leaf links are the live coin.it canonical origin URLs; the domain differs from the roster's coincasa.it by design (Rule 3), which is documented here.
